# ARLing Renewals

Invite-only pilot for tracking supplier documents, expiry dates and human review. The public interactive example uses fictional browser-only records. It does not upload files.

- English: https://arling.sk/renewals/
- Slovak: https://arling.sk/renewals/sk/
- German: https://arling.sk/renewals/de/
- Example CSV: https://arling.sk/renewals/example-import.csv
- Privacy: https://arling.sk/privacy/

Hosted on the ARLing server. Records are exportable. The application does not use external AI APIs. Workspace and supplier portal are in English. PDF/JPEG/PNG up to 5 MB; human approval or rejection; internal reminders; CSV/JSON record export. Document files download individually. No automatic reminder email, no automatic legal/insurance assessment, no active published price. Pilot terms must be agreed before real documents are used.

Invited users: https://homelab.tailbf8f27.ts.net/renewals/
